The '''''Mega''-class Star Dreadnought''', also known as the '''''Mega''-class Star Destroyer''', the '''Mega Star Destroyer''', or the '''First Order Mega-Destroyer''', was a class of [[Star Dreadnought]] utilized by the [[First Order]] during their [[First Order-Resistance War|conflict]] with the [[Resistance]]. It was believed to be the largest ship ever constructed in galactic history.

==Design and capabilities==
[[File:SupremacyUnderside-SWBC54.png|thumb|left|250px|The ventral surface of a ''Mega''-class dreadnought]]
The ''Mega''-class [[Star Dreadnought]] was more than 60 [[kilometer]]s wide, and almost 13 kilometers long.<ref name="Ships and Vehicles 4" /> It could carry six [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers]] in the aft portion of the wings, as well as two internally.<ref name="TLJ:ICS" />

Powered by at least six fusion reactor complexes,<ref name="TLJ:ICS" />the ''Mega''-class had around 32 sublight [[engine]]s,<ref name="Sphero" /> as well as a [[hyperdrive]]. It also housed a [[hyperspace tracker]], found on other [[starship]]s as well.<ref name="Episode VIII" /> It could carry 2,225,000 personnel,<ref name="TLJ:ICS" /> included [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] and [[officer]]s. The ship had a throne room for [[Snoke]], [[Supreme Leader]] of the [[First Order]], as well as several automatic laundromats.<ref name="Episode VIII" /> Designed to be fully self-sufficient, the ''Mega''-class had on-board factories, foundries, ore-processing plants, and two shipyards.<ref name="TLJ:ICS" />

In addition, the vessel possessed heavy [[turbolaser]]s, anti-ship [[missile]] batteries, and [[tractor beam projector]]s.<ref name="TLJ:ICS" /> The ship carried a large amount of various military vehicles, including [[First Order dropship|dropships]], [[First Order All Terrain Armored Transport|All Terrain Armored Transports]], [[First Order All Terrain Scout Transport|All Terrain Scout Transports]], and [[All Terrain MegaCaliber Six]] [[walker]]s.<ref name="Episode VIII" />

==History==
[[File:AttackOnTheResistanceFleet-TLJ.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Supremacy'' attacks the Resistance fleet.]]
The sole ''Mega''-class [[Star Dreadnought]] in the [[First Order Navy]] was the ''[[Supremacy]]'', the [[flagship]] of [[Supreme Leader]] [[Snoke]] as well as the ''de facto'' [[capital]] of the [[First Order]].<ref name="Last Jedi Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The ''Supremacy'' suffered extensive damage while [[Battle of Oetchi|attacking]] the [[Resistance navy|Resistance fleet]] when [[Vice Admiral]] [[Amilyn Holdo]] [[Holdo maneuver|rammed]] it near [[lightspeed]] with the heavy cruiser [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']], slicing the [[Dreadnought]] in two and also destroying a number of its escort [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers]]. Despite the heavy damage, the ''Supremacy'' remained functional, but it was later abandoned and scuttled by the First Order Navy due to being too heavily damaged to repair.<ref name="Episode VIII" />
